title: SG-1.1 Configure Tailwind and the UI stack in game/frontend
summary: Tailwind, PostCSS, design tokens, cn helper, shadcn/Radix and Lucide/Motion are really wired in game/frontend
description: Context: game/frontend has only react, react-dom and yaml in package.json; no Tailwind or PostCSS config exists and src/styles.css is plain CSS. Desired behavior: Tailwind is configured with design tokens, a cn helper exists, shadcn/Radix dependencies are installed and used, and Lucide/Motion are used by real UI. Expected result: the stack is exercised by shipped components, not only listed. Why: later SG-1 slices build the pixel-art shell on it.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/frontend, when the build config is read, then tailwind.config.ts and postcss.config.js exist and process src/styles.css
Given styles.css, when read, then it contains the three @tailwind directives and design token CSS variables
Given the cn helper, when called with conflicting Tailwind classes, then the last wins
Given GameLayout, when rendered, then it uses a shadcn-style Button, a Lucide icon and a Motion element while the existing drawer behavior is unchanged

in_scope: game/frontend package.json, Tailwind/PostCSS config, styles.css, cn helper, ui Button, GameLayout toggle
out_of_scope: Phaser, Zustand, header, modals, backend changes
preserve: Existing .game-layout/.story-panel CSS and drawer toggle behavior

technical_constraints: Use Tailwind CSS with PostCSS in Vite
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered and unit tests pass
